facts.fact: The Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill 2026 is before Sierra Leone's Parliament, with CHRDI's memorandum sent to the Legislative Committee ahead of the Committee of the Whole House report.
facts.system: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill 2026

facts.fact: The Bill proposes a Data Protection and Right to Access Information Authority, not yet constituted, per CHRDI.
facts.system: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Authority
